headline: Critical flag definitions for ripgrep functionality
what_breaks: crates/core/flags/mod.rs — relies on FLAGS for flag definitions
crates/core/flags/parse.rs — depends on Flag implementations for parsing
crates/core/flags/complete/bash.rs — uses flag definitions for completion scripts
why: This file defines all the flags available in ripgrep, which are crucial for its command-line interface. Changes to the FLAGS constant or the Flag implementations can affect multiple dependent modules and their functionalities.
checklist: Review any changes to the FLAGS constant for impact on dependent files.
Ensure all Flag implementations are correctly defined and ordered.
Check for consistency in flag names and their corresponding functionalities.
Update documentation comments if any flag definitions change.
